_doc: Brain configuration. Copy, rename, and edit. Paths are relative to where brain.py is run (experiments/embodied/).
_comment_name: Display name shown in game HUD and monitor. Use something short and unique.
name: my-brain
_comment_brain_path: Save and load path for weights (.npz). On startup, loaded automatically if the file already exists. Use empty string to run without saving.
_comment_log_path: Append-mode CSV training log. Empty string = no log.
_comment_world_config: Ruleset this brain was trained on. Used in headless mode; informational in connected mode.
_comment_res_size: Reservoir neuron count. Larger = more capacity but slower. Presets: 256 (CPU toy), 729, 2187, 4096 (default), 8192, 16384 (RTX 4090).
_comment_spectral_radius: Largest eigenvalue of the recurrent weight matrix. <1 = echo state (stable fading memory), >1 = chaotic. Keep close to 1.
_comment_noise_scale: Internal reservoir noise injected at each step. Acts as a regulariser and prevents fixed-point attractors. Typical: 10–100.
_comment_alpha: Leaky-integrator rate [0,1]. 1.0 = no leakage (full state update each step). Lower values give slower, smoother dynamics.
_comment_explore_noise: Gaussian noise added to the fwd and turn action outputs before tanh. Drives exploration. Set to 0 for pure exploitation (inference).
_comment_eat_threshold: Raw eat-output value above which the eat action fires. 0.0 = eat whenever the output is positive.
_comment_learn_lr: Actor learning rate — scales the RPE-weighted eligibility trace update to W_out.
_comment_critic_lr: Critic learning rate — how fast valence_pred tracks the running reward signal.
_comment_trace_decay: Eligibility trace decay per step. 0.99 ≈ 1.7-second memory at 60 fps. Lower = shorter credit-assignment horizon.
_comment_weight_decay: L2 regularisation on W_out applied every step. Prevents unbounded weight growth. Typical: 1e-5 to 1e-4.
_comment_assess_every: How often (in steps) the KnowledgeTracker runs K(d_ext) assessment. Logged alongside the reward summary.
_comment_log_capacity: Rolling window size for the observation log used by the KnowledgeTracker. 5000 ≈ 83 seconds at 60 fps.
_comment_seed: Random seed for reservoir weight initialisation. Different seeds give different fixed reservoirs.
_comment_action_feedback: If true, feed the previous (fwd, turn, eat) triple back into the reservoir input each step (input_dim += 3).
_comment_decision_interval: Hold each action for N game frames before computing a new one. 1 = every frame. Higher values commit to actions longer, producing smoother movement and preventing frame-to-frame oscillation. 12 ≈ 5 decisions/sec at 60 fps.
_comment_device: Compute device: 'cuda' or 'cpu'. Overridable at runtime with --device.
